newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Results of Argentine gold tender within 45 days.
newsitem.headline: Results of Argentine gold tender within 45 days.

text.p: Argentine firm Yacimientos Mineros Aguas de Dionisio (YMAD) will announce results of an exploration and development gold tender in Catamarca province within 45 days, YMAD president Americo Timonieri said Monday.
Three bidders last Thursday submitted offers for a 230-square-km site, which offered "substantially" better terms for YMAD than earlier proposals they had made, Timonieri said.
According to the tender rules YMAD has 45 days to choose a winner, he said. But he added "I think it will come sooner."
He said one of the bids would certainly be selected.

Bidders were MRN Explorations SA, Le Source Development Argentina and Eastcan Mining Ltd. In their first offers, YMAD said each bidder proposed spending about $20 million, and Catamarca Mining Secretary Raul Galarza said that the bids included proposed payments of around $2.0 million for YMAD.

MRN is a joint-venture between MIM Holdings Ltd and North Ltd, both of Australia, with Canada's Rio Algom Ltd. These three companies are already partners in the billion-dollar Bajo de la Alumbrera copper and gold project adjacent to the property now being tendered.
Le Source is made up by Australia's Normandy Mining and French company BRGM. Eastcan is from Canada.
